beach_card.definition: A card to play in your city, only placed in the TOP row of your city.

street_card.definition: A feature card with a boardwalk. Placed in the BOTTOM row of your city.

food_truck.definition: Select a card above it to gain a sand dollar; then it advances one space to the right.  If in same column as foodie will award double bonus.

foodie.definition: Select a card above it to move one person one space; then it advances one space.  If in same column as food truck will award double bonus.

sand_dollar.definition: Currency gained from placement actions; spent to use Sand Dollar Action tiles.

local.definition: Blue visitor meeple. In final movement each local may move up to 3 spaces.

tourist.definition: Orange visitor meeple. In final movement each tourist moves 1 space.

vip.definition: Green Very Important Person. Leaves a footprint on cards matching your starting tile's attributes.

footprint.definition: Marker left when a VIP moves to/through a matching card; scores per matching attribute at game end.

local_spot.definition: Location tag for places locals like.

business.definition: Location tag for shops and restaurants.
